experiment: Closed-loop SG+ESS/PV black-box ambient synthetic waveform, 4 x 120-s stages

estimators.baseline: SAME WMU 1-cycle 240-Hz features as proposed, ARX input/output fit selected by chronological hold-out, spectral apparent-inertia conversion
estimators.proposed: WMU 1-cycle features, DPSS multitaper, non-overlap 8.53s blocks, temporal CV, constrained nonnegative response dictionary, iteratively reweighted ridge, block bootstrap

not_claimed: No proof of universal separation of droop and inertia
No IEEE 39-bus EMT system or real grid measurements
No exact reimplementation of published Tuttelberg ARMAX inertia estimator
Synthetic excitation intentionally broadband up to 9.5Hz; a real power-grid ambient spectrum can be much narrower
Stationary block bootstrap underestimates total error; displayed band adds heuristic heldout model-mismatch margin, NOT a calibrated statistical confidence interval
